column36: Energy Gained - Regen Effects (Rel. to old Base)

column4: 1. Any “chunk” energy gains (think Demolitionist-like perks that provide a direct amount) and any energy recharge scalars (think Crown of Tempests) will also now be scaled by your stat investment.
2. 70 Stat value is equivalent to pre-EoF benefit granted. 70+ provides more energy
3. At low stat investment (0-30) your abilities will be recharging slower than they used to, but at high investment 70-100, they will be recharging faster.

4. Improves the Super energy gained from damaging targets and the amount of Super energy gained from external sources and any Super regeneration speed scalars from other sources. It does not change the base cooldown time of your Super.
